question: Bratislavský Most SNP s reštauráciou UFO je ako jediný most na svete členom medzinárodnej federácie, do ktorej patrí aj parížska Eiffelovka či torontská CN Tower. Federácia čoho?
source_excerpt: It is a member of The World Federation of Great Towers.

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks see the UFO bridge as just a bridge with a funny restaurant on top. It turns out that, officially, it belongs to the world's club of famous towers. The Eiffel Tower and CN Tower act as footholds, so the player can work out the answer instead of having to know it.
extra.verification_notes: Most SNP is a member of the World Federation of Great Towers per Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Most_SNP); I found no other bridge member or newer change, though the 'only bridge' claim was not checked against the full member list.

explanation: Vďaka pylónu s vyhliadkou UFO vo výške približne 85 metrov ho Svetová federácia veľkých veží prijala medzi seba. Je to jediný most v klube, ktorý inak tvoria najslávnejšie veže sveta.

question: Oravský hrad si kedysi zahral vo filme sídlo upíra, v jednom z najslávnejších nemých hororov všetkých čias. Ako sa ten film volá?
source_excerpt: Scenes from the 1922 film were shot at the castle, which stood in for Count Orlok's castle in Transylvania.

extra.why_interesting: Orava Castle is a school-trip staple, and few people think of it as a film star. Its part as the home of cinema's first great vampire is a delightful twist. Many adults know the name Nosferatu, and the word 'upír' gives a strong foothold.
extra.verification_notes: Orava Castle served as Count Orlok's castle in the 1922 silent film Nosferatu, per Wikipedia's Orava Castle article; nothing newer supersedes this.

explanation: Režisér Murnau v ňom natáčal hrad grófa Orloka, prvého veľkého filmového upíra. Na hrade sa dodnes konajú nočné prehliadky, na ktorých vás Nosferatu môže prekvapiť.
